feasibility.high_roi_first_scope: A named-source historical/symbolic color-label and layer glossary:explicit user-selected colors or fictional teaching swatches retrieve verified documentary entries with source locators. No portrait analysis or detected field.
feasibility.deterministic_component: If later useful,canonical color input parsing and RGB/hex validation are ordinary color calculations,not measurements of a spiritual aura. Source-defined meanings must be verified separately before a useful reference release.
feasibility.subjective_component: User reports of colors/feelings remain subjective descriptions. A source can be summarized without claiming it establishes a real energy structure or diagnosis.
feasibility.optical_component: RGB values or photographed light effects and hypothetical spiritual aura interpretations are separate claims. The retrieved primary-paper abstract explains Kirlian color effects through corona discharge;ordinary camera photos do not thereby validate supernatural energy fields.
feasibility.avoid: No aura diagnosis,healing efficacy prediction,emotion/personality inference from portraits,medical recommendations,clairvoyance certification or hardware experiments.
feasibility.access_gate: Both ranked sources are copyrighted and procedural pages/plates remain unverified. Legitimate excerpt/rights review first;bounded separately registered public-domain source search is possible if needed,without changing rankings or false attribution.
